title: Meta adds an FDA-cleared hearing enhancement feature to supported Meta Glasses for Meta One subscribers or a one-time cost of $149, rolling out later this year (Cheyenne MacDonald/Engadget)
summary: Cheyenne MacDonald / Engadget: Meta adds an FDA-cleared hearing enhancement feature to supported Meta Glasses for Meta One subscribers or a one-time cost of $149, rolling out later this year — But it'll cost you extra. — Meta's AI Glasses are getting a new feature made for wearers with hearing loss.
